title: How Much Hate with #china? A Preliminary Analysis on China-related Hateful Tweets Two Years After the Covid Pandemic Began
reasoning: The paper focuses on an empirical analysis of hate speech on Twitter related to China and the COVID-19 pandemic. While the authors use a standard definition of hate speech that includes religion as a protected characteristic, the study itself does not evaluate or benchmark religious beliefs, faith traditions, or moral/ethical systems; its analysis is centered on nationality, race, and ethnicity.
